functionalReqs: get(key) returns the value or a miss; marks key as recently used
put(key, value) inserts or updates; evicts LRU when at capacity
hints: Which structure gives O(1) lookup, and which gives O(1) move-to-front and remove-from-back?
HashMap of key → node in a doubly linked list. Now split storage from the eviction policy.

Cache<K,V> uses Storage (HashMap) and an EvictionPolicy interface (keyAccessed, evictKey); LRUPolicy uses a DLL with sentinel nodes; LFUPolicy uses frequency buckets; thread safety via a ReentrantReadWriteLock or segment locks.
problemStatement:
Design a **fixed-capacity cache** with O(1) `get` and `put` that evicts the least recently used entry when full.

Then make the eviction policy pluggable (LRU, LFU) and the cache safe for multiple threads.
title: Design an LRU Cache
